theorems.name: Submission.lpf_lipschitz_c1_immersion_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → LocallyLipschitzOn Ω u → ∃ (G : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl Q) (O E : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)), (∀ k, IsOpen (O k)) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ O k, ∀ w' ∈ O k, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖G k w - G k w'‖) ∧ (∀ k, MeasurableSet (E k)) ∧ (∀ k, E k ⊆ O k ∩ Ω) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint E) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ w ∈ E k, u w = G k w ∧ HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ (G k) w) w) ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n)), w ∈ Ω → (∃ D : Eucl n →L[ℝ] Eucl Q, HasFDerivAt u D w ∧ Function.Injective D) → w ∈ ⋃ k, E k
